title: Mushroom Nut Pâté (Vegan)

content:
We found out what your veggie wrap was missing. It's this pâté. Luckily, we have the recipe for you... so there is no need to miss out again!

Quick Tip: Salads or veggie wraps alone not filling you up? Adding satiating flavor of mushrooms along with seeds and nuts containing healthy fats help to transform just a salad into a hearty meal.

INGREDIENTS

2 portobello mushrooms

1/2 C. almonds

1/4 C. walnuts

1/2 C. sunflower seeds

1/2 onion

1 sweet red pepper

1 carrot

1/4 bunch cilantro

1/2 tsp. cumin powder

1/2 tsp. allspice powder

1/4 tsp. turmeric powder

1/2 tsp. curry powder

2 garlic cloves

1 T. pizza spice

1 T. Bragg’s Liquid Aminos

1/2 tsp. lemon juice

1/2 tsp. thyme

3 T. olive oil

DIRECTIONS

Combine all ingredients in a food processor, blending the nuts to form a paste. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

This recipe is courtesy of Zainab Fisher, a professional chef who specializes in raw and vegan cuisine. She has served as the chef at The Raw Kitchen and as a guest chef for FOX29 WFLXD and the CBS 12, Heath and Wellness Expo.
